doc.title: Wycliffe Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Agreement on the series' effect on audiences
summary: Rowe notes another interviewee described the same effect; Gordon gives the series top marks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you’re the second person just today who described the same scenario, getting in front of a group of people and all of a sudden they’re more hip than they were before the thing was shown. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
And for that reason I say A plus plus.
